figurative_meaning_en: sarcastically or jokingly, a straightforward and simple person
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুই তো একটা বান্দা, যা বলব তাই করবি।
ওকে বান্দা ভেবো না, সে খুব চালাক।
example_sentences_in_english: You're such a pushover, you'll do whatever I say.
Don't think he's an easy mark; he's actually very clever.
note: The idiom derives from the literal sense of captivity, implying someone easily controlled, often used teasingly in everyday Bengali speech.
